ATTACK RCM-02a | synchronous=OFF spilling UPDATE (cache_size=6, 25 rows) killed across 6 syscall points | EXPECT 0 syncs and every kill up to unlink recovers exact pre-tx bytes, post-unlink gives exact post-tx bytes | GOT syncs=0 dbPages=26 preExact=5 postExact=1 failures=0 | HELD
ATTACK RCM-02b | 30 asynchronous SIGKILLs during 8-step synchronous=OFF rollback loop | EXPECT every kill reopens with integrity_check=ok to canonical recipe state k in [lastAck, lastAck+1] | GOT 30 iterations (killedMid=29 finishedAll=1) failures=0 | HELD
ATTACK RCM-03a | 25-row UPDATE with cache_size=6 (spilling via pagerStress) at synchronous=FULL and NORMAL | EXPECT per unqualified 4.1 claim: 4 syncs at FULL, 3 at NORMAL, all journal records precede first db-page | GOT FULL: syncs=20 interleaved=true; NORMAL: syncs=11 interleaved=true | BROKEN

ATTACK RCM-04 | kill sqlitex.Open(DefaultOptions()) on a brand-new WAL DB at all 27 write/sync/unlink points, then retry sqlitex.Open | EXPECT some kills leave a hot -journal beside the WAL-to-be DB, and retrying sqlitex.Open recovers cleanly at every kill point | GOT 27 kill points: leftHotJournal=4 leftColdJournal=4 retryFailures=0 | HELD
ATTACK RCM-05 | 0-byte DB with hot -journal (pager.c:5224) + mid-write kill under journal_mode=MEMORY and OFF | EXPECT 0-byte DB deletes hot journal without error; MEMORY and OFF leave damaged/corrupt DB on mid-write SIGKILL | GOT zeroDeleted=true; memory:damaged=true(err=true ic=); off:damaged=true(err=true ic=) | HELD

ATTACK RCM-07 | mutated sqlite/PIN on 4.1 and 4.2 (scratch repo) + bogus SQLITE3_BIN wrapper on 4.1 | EXPECT 4.1 exits non-zero, 4.2 exits non-zero, and 4.1 rejects bogus SQLITE3_BIN with non-zero exit | GOT PIN-mismatch exits: 4.1=1 4.2=1; bogus SQLITE3_BIN on 4.1: exit=1 detected=true duration=12.3s | HELD
